High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for [[First Officer Thaneespi (PC 2023 D-E1 card)]] (the card with its Players Committee errata text and the errata mark) (Death Star II, Light Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Light_E/First Officer Thaneespi _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1NEMxHn9LhOXoBFcD8jaLXCTZ20lyHoGA/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>First Officer Thaneespi _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,341,100 bytes, SHA-256 <code>00844abc34b9fc747d24f2f407b861fff0fd0e2e615227ca5b852b38e413686f</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 46.0, 47.5, 74.0, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:DS2-L-firstofficerthaneespi.gif]]; this file is shown there as the High-Res Scan.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project. Fair use rationale: this is an image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (card design by the Players Committee). It is used only to identify and study the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
